doc_friction.issue: The overnight brief said to verify with node --test in the venture, but the venture's own <slug>-ci.yml was removed when PR #11268 merged (ventures-tests.yml covers node --test). A browser job therefore needed a new workflow, and the gitops runs-on README count had to be re-synced by hand (sync_readme_counts.py).

deviations.why: Added a per-venture workflow (shed-designer-browser.yml) although ventures/CLAUDE.md says a venture needs no <slug>-ci.yml just for node --test: this one installs Playwright and axe-core, which ventures-tests.yml does not, so the browser tests otherwise always skip in CI.

notes: Audit before #11268 merged (read-only): Playwright drive at 1366x900 and Pixel 7 found the end view drawing raw instead of auto-resolved pitch/overhang (5/12, 12" vs built 4/12, 7"), eave drag overridden by autoOverhang, handles with role=button but no key handlers, Ctrl+Shift+Z broken (e.key 'Z'), every keystroke committing ("" and "1" built 4 ft sheds, several undo steps), phone handles 12-19 px, 3D labels overlapping on phone. Latency, median of six pitch edits, sync handler time, headless swiftshader: before 85 ms (12x8) / 175 ms (40x20); after 26 / 50. Local verification: node --test 100 pass 0 fail (browser tests with Playwright 1.63 + axe-core 4.13.0); typecheck 0 diagnostics; clauses pass; validate_workflows all valid; sync_tree_counts --check agrees; gitops/tests/test_ci_runner.py 24 pass after sync_readme_counts.py. The browser tests were written after the fixes; their failures on the old code are shown by the audit script output, not by running the test file against it (it relies on data-key hooks the fix adds).
